title: Integrated Circuit Layout Editor — Overview and definition
t: Integrated Circuit Layout Editor — Overview and definition
description: Draws and verifies chip layouts down to the transistor polygon.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Draws and verifies chip layouts down to the transistor polygon. An integrated circuit layout editor places transistors, routes metal layers, and runs DRC/LVS against foundry rule decks for full-custom and analog chips. Real implementations include KLayout (open), Cadence Virtuoso, and Synopsys Custom Compiler. It supports parametric cells, guard rings, matching structures, and EM/IR analysis hooks.
capabilities: Polygon editing with foundry PDK layers and purposes
Parametric cells (pcells) for transistors and passives
DRC with foundry rule decks and LVS against schematics
Density, antenna, and EM/IR checks
Tape-out export: GDSII/OASIS with fill

description: Draws and verifies chip layouts down to the transistor polygon.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Integrated Circuit Layout Editor, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Polygon editing with foundry PDK layers and purposes). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Polygon editing with foundry PDK layers and purposes and Parametric cells (pcells) for transistors and passives. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Semiconductor device modeling software) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
